The following events took place in '''2989 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Talecalle volcano chain]] on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tujiamoor]] erupts for the last time before entering a period of dormancy. The volcano chain remains inactive for three [[Time/Legends|millennia]] before erupting again in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], possibly as a result of [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Ils Ee]] manipulating the ancient [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] artifact [[Sharka'k Noor]].<ref name="Corellia Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>
